name: io.github.tonyyang0504/bigcommerce-mcp
description: BigCommerce (ecommerce channels): me, create_listing, update_listing, end_listing, set_inventory, li

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_BIGCOMMERCE_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Store-level API account access token (Settings > Store-level API accounts; scopes Products modify, Orders modify) sent as the X-Auth-Token header.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_BIGCOMMERCE_STORE_HASH
environmentVariables.description: Permanent store hash from the API path (https://api.bigcommerce.com/stores/{store_hash}/...), shown with the API account.
